verdicts.human_summary: Early-return detection won't recognize already-transformed default exports wrapped in TS syntax (as/satisfies); needs to unwrap before testing for CallExpression/Identifier
verdicts.reasoning: AI Comment 0 identifies the exact same issue: node.declaration is accessed directly without unwrapping TS type annotation syntax, so expressions like 'export default defineMain({}) satisfies StorybookConfig' won't be recognized as already transformed. Both comments suggest using config._unwrap() as the fix, referencing its use elsewhere in the file.
